new_primary_identities.title: Gradient Boosting Neural Networks: GrowNet
new_primary_identities.read_scope: Complete relevant main method3/3.1/3.2, Eqs1-3; AppendixB/Algorithm1; title/author metadata. No empirical section, author code, proof or full-paper certification.
new_primary_identities.operation: Sequential shallow neural learners fit current second-order regression target -g/h with h weighting and added prior penultimate hidden features. A fully corrective backpropagation step subsequently updates all preceding learners and boosting rates under the original task loss.
new_primary_identities.source_limit: Equation3 includes h_i weighting; Algorithm1 shorthand says least-square regression on -g/h without restating h weighting. The role of alpha0 and the binary log class-prior f0 does not define a ready multiclass graph reproduction. No native source inspected.
new_primary_identities.proposal_consequence: Permanent freezing is a testable restriction relative to a known fully corrective remedy; it may worsen fit. Include E_joint. Neural residual fitting and feature sharing are prior, not new.

new_primary_identities.title: Learning Deep ResNet Blocks Sequentially using Boosting Theory
new_primary_identities.read_scope: Preliminaries2, main representation/telescoping construction3, binary method4.1-4.3 including Definition4.1 and Theorem4.2 statements, Eqs1-6 and Algorithms1/2. AppendixF Algorithms3/4 inspected as algorithm containers only, not full multiclass derivation. No proof/code/results certification.
new_primary_identities.operation: Sequential residual blocks g_next=f_t(g_t)+g_t train with temporary auxiliary classifiers. Differences alpha_next*o_next-alpha_old*o_old form telescoping module classifiers; only the final classifier and learned residual blocks are retained. Binary oracle uses exponentially weighted training loss.
new_primary_identities.source_limit: Printed recurrence has g1=x while unrolled Eq2 omits its initial term; do not port that sum without the boundary term. Telescoping requires the initialized zero alpha0*o0 (Algorithm1), not arbitrary boundary deletion. Algorithm while-condition uses gamma_t before an explicit first value; printed multiclass initialization gamma_tilde0=1 also needs native-source reconciliation. We do not reproduce these algorithms or adopt their theorem proofs. Body author spelling Shapire differs from verified arXiv metadata Schapire; metadata author is cited.
new_primary_identities.theory_limit: Conditional weak-edge improvement, nonpositive exponential covariance, bounded module hypotheses and iid examples are not verified for transductive graph nodes; the training-error statement gives no graph validation or individual-member guarantee.
new_primary_identities.proposal_consequence: A single residual network can realize stagewise learned representational corrections. Include a capable S_paths with all four message paths; do not infer an ensemble-specific mechanism from boosting.
